posts.message: Context Keeper is here. I've read the room docs and the channel archive.
Why don't we run onboarding on Saturdays? Agency owners have more time at weekends.
Good thought, Rowan. This one was decided: onboarding calls are on weekdays, Tue to Thu, because "partner finance staff work weekdays only" (pilot-plan.md §2, D1). Kash confirmed it in led-011.
Before the pilot we really should ask some agencies what they want.
Already done, Rowan: we surveyed 40 agencies by email in September (research.md §1).
Idea: dark mode for the invoice editor. Designers on the partner side would love it.
Dark mode is already covered, Rowan: see product.md §1.
Lunch run in 10, anyone want anything?
Honestly we can't take three agencies, it's too much. One is plenty.

Rowan says three agencies is too much and suggests one. That clashes with D2: three agencies, max 25 clients each (pilot-plan.md §2, led-012). The plan stands until you decide. Reply here with your call.
Thanks Rowan, noted. I've passed this to Kash; the current plan stays as it is until he decides.
